about: The badge at the start of each task row in Hero > Achievements > Area Tasks, cut from screenshots of the game at its normal interface size. Each area has its own emblem; the frame and the number (5, 10, 15, 25) are the tier. A done task has a green tick over the badge, a locked one is grey with a lock. Each entry is the top-left corner of a 28 x 28 cell in badges.png. Lumbridge, Morytania, Seers' Village, Tirannwn, Underworld and Wilderness are not in it yet: no screenshot of their tasks.
